name: Annie Varghese
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Heart failure with reduced EF: stable on sacubitril/valsartan, bisoprolol, spironolactone, furosemide, dapagliflozin. No dyspnea at rest, mild exertional fatigue. Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cut-off). Plan: continue meds, monitor weight, low‑salt diet.
- Obesity: BMI 31. Orlistat 120 mg TID with meals. No GI side‑effects. Plan: reinforce low‑calorie diet, encourage walking 15 min daily.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency: on methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. No neuropathy symptoms. Plan: continue supplementation.
Due: HbA1c 2025-07-02.
